rows.en: Hit 'em hard!
I'm leaving close combat to you.
In love and war, patience is key.
Sometimes you need to pull back.
Defend yourself!
Go on, make it flashy!
Let 'em have it!
Put some spirit into it!
All right!
rows.notes: Heard 'zero shaa'; guessed osshaa! (all right!), a skill shout between 'yosshaa!' (175) and 177.

rows.en: Looks like you went and made me mad.
OK!
Aye aye!
You got it!
Captain, calm down a little.
rows.notes: taichou = Captain (the player as team leader).

rows.en: Captain, you're getting way too carried away.
Captain, this is getting dangerous!
Captain... how could you leave me behind?
No! This can't be happening!
Captain...!
rows.notes: Only the word taichou (2.4 s), cried out.

rows.en: My heart won't stop pounding.
What a lovely song. It makes my heart flutter.
I can't stop it! My heart won't stop racing!
Ooh! Captain, you're so cool!
That's our Captain! Way to go!
That's my darling.
Eeek! Basara!
rows.notes: Basara-sama: honorific dropped per voice style.

rows.en: Sorry about that. Thanks for the rescue.
Oh my, you saved me.
Oh my, you're pretty good.
Your skills aren't bad at all.
First, please calm down.
rows.notes: Polite register in the TF partner lines 210-212.

rows.en: You're a bit too far forward.
This is getting dangerous!
This is just too cruel.
No way. You're joking, right?
Damn it! Who the hell did this?!
Impressive as always.
Ooh, that gives me shivers!
Get in my way and I'll kill you!
rows.notes: Partner lines with a male player (300-331).

rows.en: Sorry, but I have the right to choose my men too.
Teaming up with you is the worst!
I'm counting on you.
Let's go. Follow me.
Don't let your guard down.
Do your best. I'm expecting great things.
This is a piece of cake for us.
With you, success is guaranteed.
Don't worry. I may not look it, but I'm the devoted type.
If you do well, I'll give you a reward later.
Being with you makes me go all mushy.
Don't you ever show me your face again!
You're a real disappointment.
What a useless man.
Keep it up next time too.
I expect you to handle at least this much.
The mission's over. Shall we head home?
You've gotten a little better, haven't you?
Good work. You looked cool out there.
You did great. I'll give you a little praise.
Now I'm sure. You... are my... destined one.
I received your love, loud and clear.
Let my feelings reach you! ...Huh?
rows.notes: 'todoken' read as todoke(e)! - the trailing 'e?' suggests the partner reacts; kept as a surprised 'Huh?'.

rows.en: On a mission with a little girl? Just my luck.
rows.notes: Partner lines with a female player (340-371): komusume.

rows.en: So it's with you. I'm worried.
I'm so worried. Will this really be okay?
Shall we put our backs into work again today?
Relax. I'll back you up.
Don't slack off.
Two fine women together. Let's do our best.
You can do it.
Let's show them what we're made of.
You and me, the ultimate maiden duo!
I've acknowledged you. Have some confidence.
Let's wrap this up quick and go have some tea.
This is why I didn't want to work with a little girl.
Hmm, I wore myself out for nothing.
If stress ruins my skin, it's on you!
rows.notes: Compressed 'what will you do (for me) if stress ruins my skin'.

rows.en: Learn from me and be a little more ladylike.
You did well. You're pretty good.
I'll admit it, you've got skill.
